stories.title: Allahabad High Court grants interim bail to Azam Khan
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court granted interim bail to Samajwadi Party leader Mohammad Azam Khan, describing his arrest by the Enforcement Directorate as motivated and mala fide. The court noted the agency failed to follow mandatory procedures during the arrest. The petitioner was released shortly after his previous detention ended.

stories.title: Supreme Court stays conviction for Azam Khan
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has stayed the conviction of 78-year-old Azam Khan. The Enforcement Directorate had previously arrested the Samajwadi Party leader from Rampur district jail on October 31. The High Court has also granted him interim bail in a separate money laundering case.

stories.title: Opposition leaders seek answers from Election Commission
stories.summary: Thirteen INDIA bloc leaders have applied to the Supreme Court to pose 48 questions to the Election Commission. The group seeks records regarding electoral-roll revisions and voter-list changes. The application targets the Chief Election Commissioner and two election commissioners to clarify decisions made by the poll panel.

stories.title: Supreme Court criticizes Sanjay Raut over judiciary remarks
stories.summary: The Supreme Court pulled up Shiv Sena leader Sanjay Raut regarding alleged remarks about the Chief Justice of India. The bench stated that an experienced parliamentarian should exercise restraint in public statements. The court is currently hearing a criminal contempt petition filed by the Supreme Court Bar Association.

stories.title: BJP plans extensive outreach in Uttar Pradesh
stories.summary: The BJP concluded a two-day meeting in Uttar Pradesh to finalize an outreach campaign for the 2027 Assembly elections. The party aims to promote government achievements and strengthen organization down to the booth level. Discussions included coordination with alliance partners and action plans for the next three months.

stories.title: JD-U reshuffles state leadership ahead of elections
stories.summary: The Janata Dal-United has announced major organizational changes, appointing new in-charges for Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, and Madhya Pradesh. The reshuffle follows the party's preparations for upcoming assembly elections in neighboring states and the Prime Minister's scheduled visit to Bihar. New unit heads were appointed across multiple party divisions.

stories.title: Congress to begin Uttar Pradesh campaign on Constitution Day
stories.summary: The Congress party will launch its 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly election campaign on November 26. Priyanka Gandhi Vadra will lead seat-sharing negotiations with the Samajwadi Party. Leadership expressed concern over campaign delays and urged the state team to accelerate preparations following a meeting at the party president's residence.

stories.title: New alliance may impact Bahujan Samaj Party prospects
stories.summary: The Samajik Parivartan Morcha, an alliance between AIMIM and the Azad Samaj Party, is expected to draw support from Dalit and Muslim voters. Analysts suggest the move poses a significant threat to the Bahujan Samaj Party, which relies on these communities, potentially complicating its path to a political comeback.

stories.title: Amarinder Singh attends Sonia Gandhi book launch
stories.summary: Former Punjab Chief Minister Amarinder Singh attended the release of Sonia Gandhi's memoir, sparking speculation regarding his political future. Rahul Gandhi acknowledged the guest during the event. While his presence does not indicate a return to the Congress party, it has generated curiosity ahead of the Punjab polls.

stories.title: BRS cites ruling party MLA to allege corruption
stories.summary: Bharat Rashtra Samithi spokesperson Dasoju Sravan has accused the Congress government of rampant corruption. Citing remarks from a ruling party MLA, Sravan demanded an explanation from the Chief Minister. The BRS claims the internal criticism from a government member serves as a charge-sheet against the current administration.

stories.title: Nine dead as bus falls into gorge in Uttarakhand
stories.summary: A passenger bus carrying 34 people plunged into a 100-metre gorge in Tehri Garhwal on Tuesday morning. Nine passengers were killed and 25 others injured. The bus had departed from Haridwar early in the morning before crashing through a roadside railing near the Gular bridge.

stories.title: Road accidents in Uttarakhand leave 13 dead
stories.summary: Two separate accidents in Tehri and Rudraprayag districts resulted in 13 deaths and 31 injuries between Monday night and Tuesday morning. In the most severe incident, a bus plunged into a 100-metre gorge, killing nine people. Authorities reported five separate road accidents across the two districts.

stories.title: Two killed in Delhi house collapse
stories.summary: A house collapse in Delhi's Shahdara resulted in the deaths of two people, including a three-year-old child. Four other tenants were injured when the ground and first floor of the building fell on Tuesday morning. Police and emergency services responded to the site following the incident.

stories.title: Varanasi stalker kills woman and dies by suicide
stories.summary: A 20-year-old man allegedly killed a 23-year-old woman in a Varanasi hotel room before ending his own life. Police discovered the bodies after family members forced the door open. The man was reportedly enraged that the woman's marriage had been fixed. The investigation is ongoing.

stories.title: Ghaziabad murder suspect surrenders to police
stories.summary: A 26-year-old man accused of shooting his neighbour in Ghaziabad has surrendered to police. The suspect released videos confessing to the crime after being on the run since November 14. Five other suspects were arrested previously. Police are currently processing the surrender and the provided video evidence.

stories.title: Boy beaten to death over biscuit theft in Odisha
stories.summary: A 13-year-old boy was allegedly beaten to death in Odisha after being accused of stealing a packet of biscuits. Police have arrested a shop owner and his son. The arrests followed a 12-hour protest by villagers and the victim's family, who demanded action against those responsible.

stories.title: Police identify suspects in Rajasthan railway blast
stories.summary: Rajasthan Police have identified two suspects and three handlers based in Pakistan following a railway blast on November 3. Investigators used hotel registers and mobile phone locations to track the individuals. Footage also captured the suspects near the site where an explosive device was allegedly planted.

stories.title: NIA arrests drug trafficking mastermind in Assam
stories.summary: The National Investigation Agency has arrested a man in Assam identified as the mastermind behind a cross-border drug network. The arrest follows the seizure of over 236 kilograms of methamphetamine in Mizoram last year. The agency seized digital devices during the operation to dismantle the trafficking route.

stories.title: Aides of gangster Goldy Dhillon arrested
stories.summary: Police arrested two individuals linked to Canada-based gangster Gurpreet Singh, known as Goldy Dhillon, who threatened Amitabh and Abhishek Bachchan. Investigations revealed the suspects were also in contact with Vicky Haddal, another Canada-based gangster allegedly involved in recent Delhi firing cases. The police investigation remains ongoing.

stories.title: NIA probes Rajouri terror network
stories.summary: The NIA registered a case to investigate a network of over-ground workers facilitating Lashkar-e-Taiba and Jaish-e-Mohammed activities in Jammu and Kashmir. The case follows the September arrest of three individuals in Rajouri who allegedly acted as guides for Pakistani terrorists. An IED was recovered during the operation.

stories.title: IIT-Madras launches AI literacy program for teachers
stories.summary: Bodhan AI, an IIT-Madras-incubated center, will partner with education organizations to provide AI literacy to one million teachers. The initiative aims to integrate AI into existing classroom workflows through a scalable model. Implementation partners include the Learning Links Foundation, Vidya Shakti, and the Centre for Teacher Accreditation.

stories.title: Karnataka announces AI skilling initiative
stories.summary: The Karnataka government plans to train 63,200 engineering students, diploma holders, and professionals in AI technologies. The state signed memorandums of understanding with Google, Salesforce, Pega Systems, Sarvam AI, and Gnani.ai during the Bengaluru Tech Summit to meet this target. The initiative is described as an aggressive drive.

stories.title: Chennai publisher arrested in book procurement case
stories.summary: R. Mohan of Akhal Vilakku Publications was arrested following allegations of supplying fake books to government libraries. The investigation began after writer Perumal Murugan claimed that books displayed at Periyar Arivulagam were authored by unknown or non-existent individuals. The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption is handling the case.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu to exhibit seized books as evidence
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government plans to display seized books allegedly generated by AI in public libraries once the current probe concludes. Minister A. Rajmohan stated the books are being sealed to preserve them as evidence, comparing the planned exhibition to the public display of confiscated narcotics and explosives.

stories.title: Criminal case registered over library book procurement
stories.summary: The Directorate of Vigilance and Anti-Corruption registered a criminal case against a publisher and unidentified officials regarding book procurement irregularities. The probe follows evidence of forgery and corruption discovered after a complaint from the School Education Department. The investigation into the coordinating committee's activities is currently underway.

stories.title: Librarians suspended over book procurement irregularities
stories.summary: Four librarians and a Chief Accounts officer were suspended following an investigation into book purchases for the Periyar Arivulagam in Coimbatore. The suspended officials served on the coordinating and price negotiating committees. The state is currently investigating allegations of large-scale irregularities in the procurement of library materials.

stories.title: Karnataka blocks expansion of electric cab operator
stories.summary: Karnataka transport minister Byrathi Suresh blocked the expansion of Vietnamese electric cab operator Green SM. Despite the company holding a valid aggregator authorization until 2031, the minister cited concerns that low fares would cause local taxi drivers to suffer financial losses. The company has not received permission to register.

stories.title: IBM CEO says AI agents may displace 10 percent of workers
stories.summary: IBM chairman and CEO Arvind Krishna told NDTV that AI agents could displace approximately 10 percent of workers over the next five years. Krishna stated that while AI will not eliminate many jobs, it will generate different types of roles and contribute to three specific areas of work.

stories.title: Instagram tightens content recommendations
stories.summary: Meta has adjusted Instagram's recommendation algorithms in India to suggest fewer sexually suggestive posts and depictions of violence. The changes apply to accounts users do not follow, including Reels and the main feed. The update follows a government request for Meta to review its content suggestion practices.

stories.title: Delhi revokes Stage III pollution restrictions
stories.summary: The Commission for Air Quality Management lifted Stage III restrictions under the Graded Response Action Plan as air quality improved. Delhi recorded a daily average Air Quality Index of 204 on Tuesday. The watchdog cited a consistent decline in pollution levels over the past three days.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh on red alert for Cyclone Akvan
stories.summary: The India Meteorological Department issued a red alert for seven Andhra Pradesh districts ahead of Cyclone Akvan's expected landfall on November 20. Odisha has begun evacuation plans and identified six districts at high risk of landslides. The cyclone is expected to cross the coast between Nellore and Visakhapatnam.

stories.title: Odisha prepares for Cyclone Akvan
stories.summary: Odisha is emptying dams and reservoirs in Ganjam to accommodate expected rainfall from Cyclone Akvan. The India Meteorological Department forecasts the storm will cross the Andhra Pradesh coast on November 20 as an extremely severe cyclone with wind speeds of 120 to 130 kilometers per hour.

stories.title: ONGC controls gas leak in Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: ONGC engineers successfully controlled a gas leak at a re-drilling site in the Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Konaseema district on Tuesday. The leak occurred during operations at Nagaram village and caused no reported casualties. The company stated it continues to monitor the situation at the site.

stories.title: Kerala to cull 26,000 birds following flu outbreak
stories.summary: Authorities will cull 26,000 birds in Alappuzha district starting Wednesday after detecting bird flu at two poultry farms. The culling operation covers a one-kilometer radius around affected farms in Ambalappuzha North, Ambalappuzha South, and Chennithala. The infection was confirmed in both chickens and quails.

stories.title: Fish die-off reported at Ooty Lake
stories.summary: Approximately 250 Indian carp were found dead at Ooty Lake on Monday, prompting concerns regarding water pollution. The Tourism Department plans to notify the Nilgiris district administration to investigate the cause of the die-off. Previous clean-up efforts have not addressed ongoing ecological concerns at the site.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu initiates turtle conservation measures
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu Forest Department has begun beach and boat patrols to protect Olive Ridley turtles ahead of their December nesting season. The Chennai Wildlife Division is conducting patrols three to four times a week along the coast from Marina Beach to Uthandi to secure nesting habitats.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu pastoralists seek wildlife board representation
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government reconstituted its State Board for Wildlife on October 28, 2026, to improve ecological governance. The move excluded traditional pastoral communities, prompting the Tamil Nadu Federation of Pastoral Peoples Sangams to demand representation. The state has yet to address the missing piece of its ecological question.

stories.title: BKS farmers' body requests climate change budget
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Kisan Sangh has urged the union government to allocate budget provisions for managing El Nino, droughts, and floods. The farmers' collective, an offshoot of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh, also requested funding for stubble management and irrigation projects across five states. The government has not confirmed the allocation.

stories.title: Quad leaders announce new Indo-Pacific initiatives
stories.summary: Leaders from the US, India, Australia, and Japan met in Manila on Tuesday to launch initiatives for maritime surveillance, trade, and connectivity. The summit marked the first meeting of the four nations in over two years, reaffirming a commitment to a free and open Indo-Pacific region.

stories.title: Quad summit concludes in Manila
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that the Quad Leaders' Summit in Manila reinforced the grouping's commitment to a peaceful Indo-Pacific. US President Donald Trump and the leaders of Australia and Japan also attended the meeting, which coincides with the tenth anniversary of the Quad's revival.

stories.title: PM Modi describes Quad as trusted partnership
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi characterized the Quad as a constructive partnership providing trusted solutions for the Indo-Pacific. The leaders of Australia, India, Japan, and the United States met in Manila on Tuesday, marking the first leaders-level engagement of Donald Trump's current presidential term.

stories.title: PM Modi calls for ASEAN cooperation on regional stability
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi arrived in the Philippines on Monday for the East Asia Summit. India proposed enhanced cooperation with ASEAN on connectivity and maritime domain awareness, stating that the two sides should use their combined capabilities to bolster regional peace and stability.

stories.title: Quad leaders launch business forum
stories.summary: Quad leaders meeting in Manila agreed to establish a Quad Business Forum for the first time. The summit, attended by PM Modi and US President Donald Trump, focused on regional peace and economic coercion. The event concluded with the departure of the Indian delegation for Delhi.

stories.title: Indian seafarer missing after tanker attack
stories.summary: One Indian national is missing and two are injured following an attack on the Panama-flagged LPG tanker MT Tara Gas in the Strait of Hormuz. The Ministry of External Affairs is coordinating with Omani authorities to monitor search and rescue operations for the remaining crew members.

stories.title: Second attack reported on LPG tanker in Hormuz
stories.summary: Union minister Sarbananda Sonowal stated that the Panama-flagged tanker TARA GAS was subjected to a second attack in the Strait of Hormuz, forcing the crew to abandon the vessel. One Indian seafarer remains missing following the incident, which occurred after an initial missile strike on Monday.

stories.title: India condemns tanker attack
stories.summary: India has condemned the attack on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz that left one Indian seafarer missing. Two other injured crew members have been admitted to a local hospital. The government has reiterated its call for an end to the targeting of commercial vessels.

stories.title: Search continues for missing seafarer in Hormuz
stories.summary: The Ministry of External Affairs confirmed that 21 of 24 Indian nationals were evacuated after a missile attack on the MT Tara Gas in the Strait of Hormuz. Two crew members remain hospitalized, and one is missing. The Indian Embassy in Oman is monitoring the rescue operation.

stories.title: Italy seeks India-EU investment agreement
stories.summary: Italian deputy prime minister Antonio Tajani called for an investment protection agreement between India and the EU. Speaking ahead of an India-Italy Business Forum, Tajani emphasized the need for digital customs procedures to accelerate the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor. The proposal remains under discussion.

stories.title: US expands AI chip export licensing requirements
stories.summary: The US Commerce Department issued an interim rule requiring licenses for AI chip exports to data centers that may provide computing power to Chinese companies. The mandate extends to transshipment networks in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, and Brazil. The rule aims to scrutinize pathways for advanced compute.

stories.title: Federal Reserve report identifies AI as financial risk
stories.summary: The US Federal Reserve's latest Financial Stability Report found that 87 percent of surveyed contacts view AI as a significant risk to the financial system. Concerns include herd behavior in trading models and potential market volatility. The Fed has warned that self-learning systems may amplify these risks.

stories.title: UBS analysts defend Nvidia valuation
stories.summary: Nvidia shares have fallen 24 percent in November. UBS analyst Tim Arcuri described market assumptions of no growth after 2028 as draconian, noting the chip giant's momentum. The firm suggests the near-term damage to the stock has already occurred despite current analyst concerns.

stories.title: Fed chair warns of AI economic impact
stories.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh stated that AI could boost productivity while simultaneously triggering widespread job losses. Speaking in San Francisco, Warsh noted that the technology represents an entirely new economic force that may eventually influence the central bank's monetary policy decisions.

stories.title: Meta updates Instagram recommendation systems in India
stories.summary: Meta announced that Instagram is using more capable AI models to filter content in India. The company stated it has recalibrated recommendation systems to limit the visibility of sexually suggestive and violent material. The update follows a government request to review content policies.

stories.title: Meta restricts violent content on Instagram
stories.summary: Meta has changed Instagram's recommendation systems in India to reduce unwanted content. The company stated it is using advanced AI models to limit sexually suggestive and violent posts. The move follows a request from the Centre to tighten checks on content that could disturb public order.

stories.title: Sustainable aviation fuel policy draft to be out soon for public comments
stories.summary: The draft policy for sustainable aviation fuel is expected to be released for public consultation within one to two weeks. The government aims to gather feedback on the proposed framework shortly, marking the next step in the policy development process.

stories.title: Earthshot Prize leaders call for environmental investment
stories.summary: Global leaders, executives, and celebrities gathered in Mumbai for the Earthshot Prize Awards to advocate for increased investment in environmental innovation. Serum Institute CEO Adar Poonawalla noted that his organization believes prevention is better than cure, emphasizing the need for collective action against climate change.

stories.title: Prince William calls youth the torchbearers of climate change movement
stories.summary: Prince William addressed the 2026 Earthshot Prize Awards in Mumbai, describing young people as the torchbearers of a global movement for change. He praised India for its innovation and ambition in navigating immense environmental pressures while working toward sustainable progress.

stories.title: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility wins Clean Our Air prize
stories.summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility received the Clean Our Air prize at the Earthshot Prize Summit in Mumbai. Managing director Suman Mishra stated the award reflects the company's success in driving the electric three-wheeler market, proving that economic growth and climate action can coexist.

stories.title: India advocates for country-driven just transition at COP31
stories.summary: India has called for a country-driven approach to the Just Transition Work Programme at the COP31 climate conference. Environment minister Bhupender Yadav stated that developing nations must determine their own pathways based on national priorities, rather than adhering to a one-size-fits-all global mechanism.

stories.title: Physicist Steven Koonin questions pace of energy transition
stories.summary: Physicist Steven Koonin argued at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit that India should prioritize economic growth over immediate decarbonization. He claimed that UN climate conferences have failed to deliver promised finance or curb emissions, suggesting nations should pursue energy in the most convenient way possible.

stories.title: ASHA workers continue indefinite protest in Karnataka
stories.summary: ASHA workers in Karnataka have launched an indefinite protest demanding a monthly honorarium of 15,000 rupees. Despite receiving assurances from Health Minister U.T. Khader that he would discuss the matter with the Chief Minister, the union representatives have refused to withdraw their agitation.

stories.title: National Centre of Ageing adopts integrated care approach
stories.summary: The National Centre of Ageing in Guindy has implemented an integrated care model for the elderly, following the World Health Organisation's ICOPE framework. The facility focuses on detecting age-related impairments to help older persons maintain their physical and mental functional independence.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu inaugurates Centre for Advanced Genomics
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu Health Minister K.G. Arunraj inaugurated the Centre for Advanced Genomics at Christian Medical College in Ranipet. The facility features next-generation sequencing platforms intended to support precision healthcare, medical education, and translational research through high-throughput genomic testing.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu to implement HPV-DNA testing in five districts
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu will launch an HPV-DNA testing program for cervical cancer in five high-burden districts, including Dharmapuri and Ariyalur. The state government has authorized the National Health Mission to cover over 124,000 women as part of the broader Tamil Nadu Cancer Care Mission.

stories.title: Poultry workers test negative for H5N1 avian influenza
stories.summary: Health Minister K.G. Arunraj confirmed that 23 poultry workers and veterinary staff have tested negative for H5N1 avian influenza. Officials had identified 54 individuals associated with affected farms in Cuddalore for screening, with the remaining test results currently pending.

stories.title: RTI findings reveal staffing and diagnostic deficits in Kollam
stories.summary: The Human Rights Protection Mission has requested an inquiry into the Government Medical College Hospital in Kollam. Documents obtained via the Right to Information Act indicate significant vacancies, equipment issues, and a high rate of patient referrals to other facilities.

stories.title: Dengue cases rise in Thiruvananthapuram
stories.summary: Thiruvananthapuram has reported a spike in dengue cases, with the Kerala University campus and Cliff House compound identified as hotspots. Health officials have recorded nearly 300 probable and confirmed cases in the last 10 days, suspecting that the actual transmission rate may be higher.

stories.title: India seeks comprehensive space security doctrine
stories.summary: Space has evolved from a scientific domain into a critical infrastructure hub for banking, navigation, and national security. As India's reliance on satellite services grows, the country faces a need for a comprehensive doctrine to manage the risks of disruption to these essential systems.

stories.title: Rajnath Singh emphasizes quality in defence manufacturing
stories.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh stated that defect-free production is essential for operational readiness. Addressing an international symposium on non-destructive testing, he emphasized that as Indian defence systems become more sophisticated, manufacturing processes must adhere to the highest quality standards to prevent mission failure.

stories.title: Wayanad to host mountain ecology congress
stories.summary: Wayanad will host the Processual Mountains 2026 congress from December 10 to 12. Organized by the Hume Centre for Ecology and Wildlife Biology, the event aims to bring together indigenous communities and researchers to discuss the future and changing ecology of mountain regions.

stories.title: The cycle of consumer trends and social media influence
stories.summary: Modern consumer culture continues to prioritize the acquisition of new trends, often driven by social media endorsements. Marketing experts note that individuals frequently purchase items based on perceived popularity, leading to a cycle where previous purchases are abandoned in favor of the latest trending product.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi recounts visit to parents' meeting spot
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi shared a personal anecdote during the launch of Sonia Gandhi's memoir, recalling a visit to the Varsity Restaurant in Cambridge. He noted that he took his girlfriend to the site where his parents, Rajiv and Sonia, first met, highlighting the mythology surrounding their history.

stories.title: Rahul Gandhi recounts parents' meeting place
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi said he visited a Cambridge restaurant with his girlfriend where his parents, Rajiv and Sonia Gandhi, first met. Speaking at the launch of his mother's memoir, he noted there is a lot of mythology surrounding his parents and their early history in the city.

stories.title: Suresh Gopi dismisses E20 petrol critics
stories.summary: Union Minister Suresh Gopi called critics of ethanol-blended petrol idiots who do not understand the science. He alleged that those testing fuel samples may be tampering with them before analysis. The minister claims the blending process is calibrated to ensure a 20 percent mix.

stories.title: Minister claims E20 blending is precise
stories.summary: Union Minister Suresh Gopi stated that ethanol-blending machines are calibrated to ensure a 20 percent mix, dismissing concerns over fuel quality as politically motivated. He claimed that no registered complaints regarding the use of E20 petrol have been filed to date.

stories.title: Minister says tiger pursuit was curiosity
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu Minister Vanni Arasu said he followed a tiger in the Mudumalai Tiger Reserve out of curiosity rather than chasing it. He claimed the controversy is a political campaign against him, noting he has been trekking in forests for 15 years without incident.

stories.title: Conservationists seek action against minister
stories.summary: Conservationists have demanded action against Tamil Nadu Minister Vanni Arasu after social media footage showed him pursuing a tiger in the Mudumalai Tiger Reserve. The video depicts the minister and his family on safari vehicles, with the minister seen running after the animal.

stories.title: Probe sought into minister's tiger reserve visit
stories.summary: A complaint to the National Tiger Conservation Authority demands an investigation into Minister Vanni Arasu's visit to a critical tiger habitat. The filing cites unauthorised entry, disturbance to wildlife, and the disclosure of sensitive locations for endangered species. The habitat is intended to remain undisturbed.
